title: Generative Modeling with Bayesian Sample Inference
abstract: arXiv:2502.07580v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present a novel view of diffusion-like generative modeling from the perspective of iterative Gaussian posterior inference. By treating the generated sample as an unknown variable, we formulate the sampling process in the language of Bayesian probability: at each step, a model predicts the unknown sample from our current belief state and we compute a posterior belief from that prediction. Based on this formulation, we propose the generative model Bayesian Sample Inference (BSI). In addition to a rigorous theoretical analysis, we show that our perspective includes Bayesian Flow Networks (BFNs) and that BSI and BFNs represent the two opposite ends of a range of isotropic hyper-priors over the initial belief state. In our experiments, we demonstrate that BSI improves sample quality over both BFNs and the closely related Variational Diffusion Models on ImageNet32 and ImageNet64, while achieving equivalent log-likelihoods on both datase

translated_title: 基于贝叶斯样本推断的生成建模
translated_abstract: arXiv:2502.07580v4 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们从迭代高斯后验推断的角度，提出了一种对扩散式生成建模的新视角。通过将生成的样本视为未知变量，我们用贝叶斯概率的语言来表述采样过程：在每一步中，模型根据当前信念状态预测未知样本，然后我们从该预测中计算后验信念。基于这一表述，我们提出了生成模型贝叶斯样本推断（BSI）。除了严格的理论分析外，我们还表明，我们的视角包含了贝叶斯流网络（BFNs），并且BSI和BFNs代表了初始信念状态上各向同性超先验范围的两个极端。在实验中，我们证明BSI在ImageNet32和ImageNet64上比BFNs和密切相关的变分扩散模型提高了样本质量，同时在两个数据集上实现了等效的对数似然。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为贝叶斯样本推断（BSI）的新生成模型，通过迭代高斯后验推断视角统一并扩展了扩散模型和贝叶斯流网络，在图像生成质量上优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Bayesian Sample Inference (BSI), a novel generative model that unifies and extends diffusion models and Bayesian Flow Networks through iterative Gaussian posterior inference, achieving superior sample quality on ImageNet benchmarks.
